name: Blackout Clock
short: A news calendar for prop-firm traders that shows which of their accounts are blocked by each firm's news rules.

images.alt: Blackout Clock desktop Now + Today view and phone Now screen (sample data)
Account rows showing locked, pairs-only and clear status with countdowns (sample data)

highlights: Now, Today and Week views show every account's lock status at a glance
Rule Radar flags when a firm changes its news rules
Always shows the rule's source: guidance, not a guarantee
Departure Board design system with split-flap countdowns
next: Build the Now screen as a mobile web app

timeline.title: Explored a broader AI trading desk
timeline.body: Researched folding Blackout Clock into a multi-agent trading assistant.

timeline.title: Design direction: Departure Board
timeline.body: A dark, airport-board look for the Now, Today and Week views.

timeline.title: Product decisions locked

timeline.title: Research and PRD
timeline.body: Mapped how prop firms restrict trading around news events.
